title: forEach does not wait for await
why_it_matters: This bug makes code run in an order you didn't expect.
explanation: forEach ignores whatever your callback returns, so it won't wait for async functions, and you can't break out of it. Here, 'finished?' prints before any 'done'. When you need await or an early exit, use a for...of loop.
try_it: Rewrite this with for...of inside an async function and compare the order.
